newsitem.title: USA: Olsten Corp sees Q4 lower than expected net.
newsitem.headline: Olsten Corp sees Q4 lower than expected net.

text.p: Olsten Corp said Thursday that ongoing margin pressures affecting its two primary businesses and reduced revenues from Medicare operations will result in lower than expected net income of about $0.20 per share for the fourth quarter and about $1.30 per share for the year 1996, exclusive of merger, integration and other non-recurring charges.
Olsten's two primary businesses are staffing and home health care services.

The company said this compares with fully diluted fourth quarter and full year 1995 net income, respectively, of $0.36 and $1.27 per share, exclusive of merger, integration and other non-recurring charges.

Projected results for the fourth quarter and fiscal year 1996 include the financial performance of Quantum Health Resources Inc and Co-Counsel Inc, acquired by Olsten Corp earlier this year and accounted for as a pooling of interests.
Prior year comparisons are restated to reflect the acquisitions of Quantum and Co-Counsel.
